name: Urdu-Newspaper-Benchmark
description: A benchmark of Urdu newspaper text intended to evaluate NLP models on news-domain Urdu language understanding and generation tasks. It is useful for downstream tasks such as classification, summarization, and language modelling in Urdu and aims to provide resources for evaluating model performance on real-world Urdu news content.
evaluation_method: accuracy / F1 (classification/NER) and BLEU or ROUGE (summarization) and perplexity (language modeling)
reputation: A niche but useful resource for Urdu NLP on Hugging Face with growing interest in regional-language benchmarks; not widely cited compared to major multilingual benchmarks.
